result:
Regression fixed. `anthrouter/http_util.py` looked up the header `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining`, but the real header is `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`. Because of the typo, the requests-remaining value was never recorded. I corrected the name.

The two failing tests now pass, along with the other 56 rate-limit tests. A full-suite run is still going in the background, so I haven't confirmed the whole suite.
